title: Research on the impact mechanism of monetary policy shocks and the synergy of human capital structure on corporate investment
title_zh: 货币政策冲击与人力资本结构协同对企业投资的影响机制研究
title_primary: 货币政策冲击与人力资本结构协同对企业投资的影响机制研究
title_secondary: Research on the impact mechanism of monetary policy shocks and the synergy of human capital structure on corporate investment
authors: Bin Hao, Zehao Wang, Lei Yin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how monetary policy uncertainty shapes corporate investment efficiency based on an unbalanced panel of 5,090 Chinese A-share listed firms over the period 2011–2024. The findings indicate that heightened monetary policy uncertainty leads to a significant deterioration in investment efficiency. This relationship remains stable after adopting alternative measures, introducing lagged terms, removing observations from the COVID-19 period, and applying instrumental-variable estimation. Mechanism analysis shows that tighter financing constraints and lower R&D expenditure constitute two important channels underlying this effect. The negative influence is particularly evident among capital-intensive and technology-intensive firms, state-owned enterprises, and firms characterized by CEO duality. Moreover, an upgraded human capital structure enhances firms’ capacity to absorb policy-related shocks and weakens the adverse effect of monetary policy uncertainty. These findings advance the understanding of firm-level responses to macroeconomic policy uncertainty and offer practical insights into policy communication, innovation financing, human capital allocation, and corporate investment management.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于2011–2024年间5090家中国A股上市公司的非平衡面板数据，考察货币政策不确定性如何影响企业投资效率。研究发现，货币政策不确定性上升会显著降低企业投资效率。在采用替代性指标、引入滞后项、剔除新冠疫情时期观测值以及运用工具变量估计后，该结论依然稳健。机制分析表明，融资约束趋紧与研发支出下降是这一效应的两个重要传导渠道。这种负面影响在资本密集型和技术密集型企业、国有企业以及董事长兼任总经理的企业中尤为显著。此外，人力资本结构升级能够增强企业吸收政策冲击的能力，从而削弱货币政策不确定性的不利影响。这些发现深化了对企业应对宏观经济政策不确定性的理解，并为政策沟通、创新融资、人力资本配置及企业投资管理提供了实践启示。关键词：货币政策不确定性；投资效率；融资约束；研发投资；人力资本结构 JEL分类号：M21 G38 M10 J24

title: Global Financial Transparency and Offshore Wealth Accumulation
title_zh: 全球金融透明度与离岸财富积累
title_primary: 全球金融透明度与离岸财富积累
title_secondary: Global Financial Transparency and Offshore Wealth Accumulation
authors: Annette Alstadsæter, Niels Johannesen, Ségal Le Guern Herry, Gabriel Zucman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper uses administrative data to analyze wealth flows from Norway to offshore tax havens before and after a major improvement of global financial transparency: automatic exchange of bank account information between tax authorities. We present three results suggesting that the policy is a significant deterrent of offshore tax evasion: First, taxpayers who become wealthy are much less likely to shift wealth to offshore banks. Second, when wealth does flow to offshore banks, it is much less likely to reduce domestic tax payments. Third, there is no increase in the use of complex ownership structures for offshore wealth flows.
abstract_zh: 本文利用行政数据分析全球金融透明度重大提升——即税务机关之间自动交换银行账户信息——前后，挪威流向离岸避税天堂的财富变化。我们提出三项结果，表明该政策对离岸逃税具有显著威慑作用：第一，新晋富裕纳税人将财富转移至离岸银行的概率大幅降低；第二，即便财富流向离岸银行，其减少国内纳税的可能性也显著下降；第三，离岸财富流动中复杂所有权结构的使用并未增加。

title: Greenwashed groceries: prevalence and patterns of environmental marketing and greenwashing in the retail food sector
title_zh: 漂绿食品杂货：零售食品行业环境营销与漂绿的普遍性及模式
title_primary: 漂绿食品杂货：零售食品行业环境营销与漂绿的普遍性及模式
title_secondary: Greenwashed groceries: prevalence and patterns of environmental marketing and greenwashing in the retail food sector
authors: Erin O’Dwyer, Jennifer Weeks, Eric B. Rimm, Kevin Cody, Emma-Louise Aveling 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Food systems must be urgently transformed given their disproportionate environmental impacts and contributions to accelerating ecological crises. As public awareness of sustainability grows, companies across consumer goods sectors are increasingly adopting environmental marketing strategies. However, there is growing concern that some of these claims may be “greenwashed” —misleading consumers about actual environmental benefits, undermining consumer trust, and impeding progress towards sustainability transformations. To investigate this issue in the food sector, we developed a novel coding instrument to identify direct and executional environmental marketing and greenwashing on food products. We applied this tool to all food and non-alcoholic beverage products available on two major online grocery platforms, estimating the prevalence of environmental marketing and greenwashing, exploring patterns by store category and claim content, and assessing the processing levels of environmentally marketed and greenwashed products using the NOVA classification system. Environmental marketing appeared on over 10% of products; of these, 65% at the conventional supermarket and 33% at the natural foods store were deemed greenwashed. Greenwashing was most prevalent in the meat and meat alternatives sections and when claims related to food waste and climate mitigation were used. Environmentally marketed and greenwashed products were disproportionately classified as ultra-processed (NOVA 4). Our findings highlight the need for stronger regulation of environmental marketing among food products as one strategy to protect planetary health and provide foundational evidence to inform its development. The replicable coding instrument developed in this study may also support future research and monitoring efforts in this area.
abstract_zh: 食品系统因其对环境的过度影响及对加速生态危机的贡献，亟需进行转型。随着公众对可持续性意识的增强，消费品行业的公司越来越多地采用环境营销策略。然而，人们日益担忧其中一些声明可能是“漂绿”——误导消费者关于实际环境效益，削弱消费者信任，并阻碍向可持续性转型的进程。为调查食品行业的这一问题，我们开发了一种新颖的编码工具，用以识别食品产品上的直接和执行性环境营销及漂绿行为。我们将此工具应用于两大在线杂货平台上所有食品和非酒精饮料产品，估算了环境营销和漂绿的发生率，探讨了按商店类别和声明内容的不同模式，并利用NOVA分类系统评估了环境营销和漂绿产品的加工水平。环境营销出现在超过10%的产品上；其中，传统超市的65%和天然食品店的33%被认定为漂绿。漂绿现象在肉类及肉类替代品区域最为普遍，且当声明涉及食物浪费和气候缓解时尤为突出。环境营销和漂绿产品不成比例地被归类为超加工食品（NOVA 4）。我们的发现强调了加强对食品产品环境营销监管的必要性，作为保护地球健康的一项策略，并为制定相关监管提供了基础证据。本研究中开发的可复制编码工具也可能支持该领域未来的研究和监测工作。

title: Designing Donor Registries: Behavioral Drivers of Enrollment and Giving
title_zh: 设计捐赠者登记系统：注册与捐赠行为的驱动因素
title_primary: 设计捐赠者登记系统：注册与捐赠行为的驱动因素
title_secondary: Designing Donor Registries: Behavioral Drivers of Enrollment and Giving
authors: Lorko, Matej, Servátka, Maroš, Slonim, Robert
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many charitable organizations invite potential donors to first join a registry before soliciting donations from those who have joined. Behavioral theories suggest that the choice architecture of registry enrollment can influence not just participation but also future giving. Some approaches may be relatively more likely to increase the likelihood of joining but reduce the subsequent propensity to donate and the amount donated, while other methods might have the opposite effect. We experimentally test four behavioral theories – overhead aversion, status quo bias, reciprocity, and moral consistency – in a two-stage donor engagement model. We find that (1) disclosing registry-related overhead costs decreases donations, (2) changing the default enrollment method (op-in vs. opt-out) does not affect enrollment nor donations, (3) targeting reciprocity by offering a small gift conditional on joining the registry boosts enrollment but not donations, and (4) targeting moral consistency by requesting an upfront contribution does not decrease the likelihood of joining the registry and can improve charity returns. Our findings emphasize how subtle differences in the design of early-stage donor approaches can influence longer-term fundraising outcomes.
abstract_zh: 许多慈善组织会先邀请潜在捐赠者加入登记册，随后再向已加入者募捐。行为理论表明，登记注册的选择架构不仅会影响参与行为，还会影响未来的捐赠意愿。某些方法可能更易提高加入登记册的可能性，但会降低后续捐赠倾向及金额；而另一些方法则可能产生相反效果。我们通过两阶段捐赠者参与模型，对四种行为理论——管理费用厌恶、现状偏差、互惠原则与道德一致性——进行了实验检验。研究发现：（1）披露与登记册相关的管理费用会减少捐赠；（2）改变默认注册方式（选择加入与选择退出）对注册率及捐赠均无影响；（3）通过提供注册后附赠小礼品来触发互惠机制，虽能提升注册率，但未增加捐赠额；（4）通过要求预先捐款来触发道德一致性，既未降低注册可能性，还能提升慈善收益。我们的研究结果强调，早期捐赠者接触方式设计中的细微差异，可能对长期筹款成效产生深远影响。

title: Bootstrap inference for matching estimator under spatially correlated effects
title_zh: 空间相关效应下匹配估计量的Bootstrap推断
title_primary: 空间相关效应下匹配估计量的Bootstrap推断
title_secondary: Bootstrap inference for matching estimator under spatially correlated effects
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a dependent wild bootstrap (DWB) procedure for inference on matching estimators in the presence of spatial dependence. The bootstrap algorithm delivers a spatial heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) variance estimator that accommodates unknown spatial dependence. By accounting for spatial correlation in the residuals, this approach improves the accuracy of standard error estimation for nonparametric matching estimators. A small Monte Carlo simulation illustrates its performance in a finite sample.

title: Policy Evaluation in the Absence of Survey Data: Customised Border Designs With Satellite Data
title_zh: 无调查数据下的政策评估：基于卫星数据的定制化边界设计
title_primary: 无调查数据下的政策评估：基于卫星数据的定制化边界设计
title_secondary: Policy Evaluation in the Absence of Survey Data: Customised Border Designs With Satellite Data
authors: Muddasir Ahmad Akhoon, Abhishek Shaw, Vidya Vemireddy
abstract: ABSTRACT Developing country governments often launch new agricultural programmes without collecting pre‐implementation survey data, making it difficult to evaluate the effects of such programmes. Leveraging the flexibility of granular pixel‐level satellite panel data and a well‐developed quasi‐experimental policy evaluation design, we study a programme where pre‐implementation data is unavailable. We estimate the effect of cash transfers on agricultural productivity in Telangana, India. Treatment and control regions are within 10 km on either side of the state border. They are identical in all respects except for the difference in exposure to policy treatment. Agricultural productivity increased in the major monsoon cropping season due to the cash transfer programme. The findings also reveal that cash transfers helped reduce productivity gaps between irrigated and rainfed agricultural areas. Our results are robust to two different sources of satellite data, three alternative indicators of productivity, two rounds of full‐scale resampling, 100 rounds of small‐scale resampling and three alternative border designs. Placebo regressions of two previous years also confirm our results. This approach to policy evaluation is applicable anywhere satellite data are available in the world.
abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家政府经常在未收集实施前调查数据的情况下启动新的农业项目，这使得评估此类项目的效果变得困难。利用高分辨率像素级卫星面板数据的灵活性以及成熟的准实验政策评估设计，我们研究了一个缺乏实施前数据的项目。我们估算了印度特伦甘纳邦现金转移对农业生产力的影响。处理组和对照组区域位于州界两侧各10公里范围内，除政策处理暴露程度不同外，其余各方面均相同。现金转移项目在主要季风种植季节提高了农业生产力。研究结果还显示，现金转移有助于缩小灌溉农业与雨养农业之间的生产力差距。我们的结果对两种不同来源的卫星数据、三种替代生产力指标、两轮全规模重采样、100轮小规模重采样以及三种替代边界设计均保持稳健。前两年的安慰剂回归也证实了我们的结果。这种政策评估方法适用于全球任何可获得卫星数据的地区。

title: Business dynamism and financial constraints
authors: Alexander Amundsen, Danny Leung, Oana Secrieru
abstract: Abstract Declining business dynamism has been observed across many advanced economies; however, its consequences have been less well studied. In this paper, we propose that declining business dynamism has led to a decrease in the financial constraints faced by firms. We use well established methods to identify financial constraints and then develop a new approach to measure the fraction of financially constrained firms. We find that the fraction has fallen over time and this is driven by rising firm age. Had business dynamism not declined, firms would be younger and more financially constrained.
abstract_zh: 许多发达经济体均观察到商业活力下降的现象，但其后果研究尚不充分。本文提出，商业活力下降导致企业面临的融资约束减少。我们采用成熟方法识别融资约束，并开发新途径衡量受融资约束企业所占比例。研究发现，该比例随时间下降，且此趋势由企业年龄增长驱动。若商业活力未下降，企业将更年轻且面临更严峻的融资约束。

title: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
title_zh: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响
title_primary: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响
title_secondary: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
authors: Fan He, Wei Huang, Yinghao Pan, Jiao Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the long-term impacts of China’s nationwide public health campaigns targeting malaria, measles, and meningitis between the 1960s and 1980s. Exploiting regional variation in precampaign disease prevalence across birth cohorts, we show that these interventions generated sizable improvements in education, cognition, health, and income. As an illustrative case, individuals from high-malaria regions who were fully exposed to the eradication campaign attained about 0.5 additional years of schooling and earned over 10% higher income in adulthood, with cognitive and schooling gains explaining a substantial share of the income effects. Extending the same approach to measles and meningitis vaccination campaigns reveals comparably large benefits, with internal rates of return ranging from 21% to 34%. Together, these findings highlight the lasting socioeconomic returns to early-life health interventions and underscore the role of public health as a foundation for human capital accumulation and long-run economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60至80年代中国针对疟疾、麻疹和脑膜炎开展的全国性公共卫生运动的长期影响。利用不同出生队列在运动前疾病流行率的地区差异，我们证明这些干预措施显著改善了教育、认知、健康和收入水平。以疟疾为例，来自高疟疾地区且完全暴露于根除运动的个体，其受教育年限平均增加约0.5年，成年后收入提高超过10%，其中认知能力和教育水平的提升解释了收入效应的很大一部分。将相同方法应用于麻疹和脑膜炎疫苗接种运动后，同样发现了可观的收益，内部收益率介于21%至34%之间。这些发现共同凸显了早期健康干预的持久社会经济回报，并强调了公共卫生作为人力资本积累和长期经济增长基础的关键作用。

title: Simple Market Structures are Incomplete
title_zh: 简单市场结构是不完备的
title_primary: 简单市场结构是不完备的
abstract: We propose a model of categorization in financial markets where states are defined by payoff-relevant variables, but all securities are measurable with respect to strict subsets of these variables. This limits insurance against variable interactions: no combination of securities can compensate the absence of an instrument targeting a given set of variables. We provide a decomposition result that identifies the uninsurable component of income risk for any market. We derive a lower bound on the number of securities required for efficiency. Using the same techniques, we characterize the payoff space when individuals condition only on a personal set of variables.

title: The new poor law and the health of the population of England and Wales
title_zh: 新济贫法与英格兰和威尔士人口健康
title_primary: 新济贫法与英格兰和威尔士人口健康
title_secondary: The new poor law and the health of the population of England and Wales
authors: David Green, Gabriel Mesevage, Graham Mooney, Simon Szreter
abstract: We estimate the impact of reductions in poor law expenditure on rural life expectancy and mortality rates in England and Wales following the 1834 Poor Law Amendment Act. Given the scale of cuts imposed, our estimates imply 8–10 per cent increases in mortality at ages 1–4 years and 2–4 per cent falls in rural expectation of life at birth. This is consistent with the reformers’ policy of reducing child allowances for larger families. These results help to explain the weak performance of national mid‐nineteenth century life expectancy measures during a period of rising real wages but falling welfare expenditure.

title: Environmental regulation informed by biased stakeholders
title_zh: 受偏见利益相关者影响的环境规制
title_primary: 受偏见利益相关者影响的环境规制
title_secondary: Environmental regulation informed by biased stakeholders
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Public consultations are widely used in regulatory processes, allowing stake-holders to present their viewpoints despite their inherent biases. Some stake-holders, such as firms, are known to be pro-business, while others, such as environmental NGOs, are pro-environment. We develop a framework to analyze how a regulator should process information provided by biased stakeholders. We distinguish between stakeholders whose biases are high and known and those whose biases are small but unknown, such as national authorities. We show that the regulator should follow the advice that runs counter to a stakeholder’s typical bias, i
abstract_zh: 公众咨询在监管过程中被广泛采用，允许利益相关者表达其观点，尽管这些观点带有固有偏见。某些利益相关者，如企业，已知倾向于商业利益，而其他如环境非政府组织则倾向于环境保护。我们构建了一个框架，分析监管者应如何处理来自有偏见利益相关者的信息。我们区分了偏见程度高且已知的利益相关者与偏见程度小但未知的利益相关者，例如国家当局。研究表明，监管者应采纳与利益相关者通常偏见相悖的建议。

title: To innovate or not to innovate? CEO’s health risk matters
title_zh: 创新还是不创新？CEO的健康风险至关重要
title_primary: 创新还是不创新？CEO的健康风险至关重要
title_secondary: To innovate or not to innovate? CEO’s health risk matters
authors: Hao Shen, Rujun Luo, Wei Wang
abstract: The upper echelons theory posits that managerial traits have important impacts on corporate strategies, but health risk, as a critical trait of CEOs, has long been overlooked. Based on data from the Chinese CDC, this paper reveals that when CEOs are confronted with higher health risks, they are likely to reduce investment in corporate innovation; managerial myopia and risk aversion play intermediary roles in the relationship. Furthermore, CEOs’ compensation and educational attainment can effectively mitigate the negative impact of health risk. The inhibitory effect of CEO health risk on corporate innovation is more evident in non-state-owned and non-high-tech firms. By incorporating managers’ health into the framework of upper echelons theory, this study extends and enriches the literature, providing robust empirical evidence that CEO health risk is a consequential driver of corporate strategic decisions.
abstract_zh: 高层梯队理论认为，管理者特质对企业战略具有重要影响，但健康风险作为首席执行官的关键特质长期被忽视。基于中国疾控中心数据，本文揭示当首席执行官面临较高健康风险时，其倾向于减少企业创新投入；管理者短视与风险规避在其中发挥中介作用。此外，首席执行官的薪酬水平与教育程度能有效缓解健康风险的负面影响。首席执行官健康风险对企业创新的抑制作用在非国有企业与非高科技企业中更为显著。通过将管理者健康纳入高层梯队理论框架，本研究拓展并丰富了相关文献，为首席执行官健康风险是企业战略决策的重要驱动因素提供了稳健的经验证据。

title: A study of the impact of port opening and trade on the efficiency of the green economy: a test based on the asymptotic spatial DID approach
title_zh: 港口开放与贸易对绿色经济效率的影响研究：基于渐进空间双重差分法的检验
title_primary: 港口开放与贸易对绿色经济效率的影响研究：基于渐进空间双重差分法的检验
title_secondary: A study of the impact of port opening and trade on the efficiency of the green economy: a test based on the asymptotic spatial DID approach
authors: Haisheng Chen Manhong Shen a Institute for Digital Economy and Industrial Innovation, Ningbo University of Finance and Economics, Ningbo, Chinab Institute of Ecological Civilization, Zhejiang A & F University, Hangzhou, China
abstract: Taking the Yangtze River Delta region of China as a case study, this study empirically demonstrates the long-run heterogeneous effects of the late Qing dynasty open port and trade policy on urban green economic efficiency using the asymptotic spatial DID methodology based on data from 2011 to 2022. The study confirms that the policy of opening ports for trade and commerce at the end of the Qing Dynasty objectively increased the long-term green total factor productivity (GTFP) and green technical efficiency (EC) of the cities, but had no significant effect on green technological progress (TC). The above effects vary according to the timing of the city’s opening, political status and heterogeneity of the power of the Great Powers. Under the combined effects of financial stability, technological progress and policy mechanisms, openness policymaking should fully consider the potential roles of political systems, legal traditions and path dependence, and innovate policies with lower implementation costs, such as green technology transfer and foreign education. This study reveals the dynamic impact of the history of economic openness on the efficiency of the green economy from both the historical and spatial dimensions, providing important insights into the path of green economic development.
abstract_zh: 以中国长三角地区为案例，本研究基于2011年至2022年的数据，采用渐近空间双重差分法，实证揭示了晚清开埠通商政策对城市绿色经济效率的长期异质性影响。研究确认，清末开埠通商政策客观上提升了城市的长期绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）及绿色技术效率（EC），但对绿色技术进步（TC）未产生显著影响。上述效应因城市开埠时间、政治地位及列强势力的异质性而有所不同。在金融稳定、技术进步与政策机制的综合作用下，开放政策的制定应充分考虑政治体制、法律传统及路径依赖的潜在作用，并创新实施成本较低的政策，如绿色技术转移与海外教育。本研究从历史与空间维度揭示了经济开放历史对绿色经济效率的动态影响，为绿色经济发展路径提供了重要启示。
